subcategory_text: Confirm and triage AI vulnerabilities by impact (data leakage, harmful output, model theft, jailbreak), exploitability, exposure, and applicable regulatory regime.
implementation_examples: Score AI vulnerabilities by data sensitivity and exploitability
Reproduce the vulnerability in a sandboxed test environment
Map findings to applicable AI regulations (EU AI Act, sectoral)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI vulnerabilities are triaged by impact and regulatory exposure.
Determine whether findings are reproducible before prioritisation.
